exposure: Different modes of second delivery (categorized into 4 groups: A, B, C, D)
outcome: Areas of the levator hiatus (resting state and Valsalva manoeuvre)
cohort: Chinese women who had a second delivery.
finding: All second delivery methods can cause varying degrees of pelvic organ prolapse and decreased pelvic floor function, but vaginal delivery as the second delivery mode may have a more significant effect in Chinese women.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery as the second delivery mode may have a more significant negative effect on pelvic floor function and pelvic organ prolapse compared to other second delivery modes in Chinese women.
